evidence_kind: Read-only inspection of recovered Android Unity assets and replacement-server source

source_apk.version_scope: Recovered APK identified by the research workspace as Android 2.41.0; not a claim about every release or the original server

world_asset.interpretation: The world-2 constant, title suffix, resource key and GameObject name consistently identify the intended destination. This inspection does not establish the native GetResourceId implementation or successful runtime loading.

zone_scope.observation: Neither recovered response type declares zone_id
zone_scope.server_join_observation: Selects a room by world_id and returns the stored zone_id unchanged
zone_scope.fixture_zone_interpretation: Opaque schema fixture copied from the established world-1 seed; not a recovered world-2 zone or spawn coordinate

minimal_synthetic_destination.room_udp_host: Copy the working world-1 fixture transport host
minimal_synthetic_destination.room_udp_port: Copy the working world-1 fixture transport port
minimal_synthetic_destination.entities: Empty destination entity collections are sufficient for a minimal fixture; this is a recommendation, not live validation

limitations: No database mutations, tests, emulator actions or service restarts were performed for this inspection
Spawn fields are intentionally omitted; zone_id is not asserted to encode a Unity coordinate
Original-server behavior and runtime destination loading are outside this static evidence
